answer: A farm running 126 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the yarrow stake is held until the nebula settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the karst audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 18% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
